title: vvv: build a video template once, reuse it across coding agents

facts.description: Build a video template once, reuse it across coding agents. Editable Remotion templates and an Agent Skill for Claude Code, Codex and 25+ agents.
facts.verified_on: macOS ARM64 with Claude Code and Codex (README)
facts.library: five editable Remotion templates, currently wedding films (README/release)

treatment.audience: video creators and developers who make short videos with coding agents
treatment.viewer_job: decide whether a reusable video template for coding agents is worth trying
treatment.hook_mechanic: open on a finished 9:16 demo film, then the one-line promise

open_loop.plant: why rebuild the same video every time?

scenes.headline: BUILD A *TEMPLATE* ONCE
scenes.say: Build a video template once, then let your coding agent reuse it for every new film.
The scenes, timing and layouts stay fixed. You change only the photos, names and copy, and it checks the inputs before anything renders.

scenes.heading: THE *CATCH*
scenes.say: The catch: it is version 0.1, the library is wedding films for now, and it is tested on macOS with Claude Code and Codex. It is free and open source.
Would you build your next video as a template? Comment template and tell me what you would reuse.

viewer.problem: every new video means rebuilding the same scenes and timing from scratch

idea: vvv turns a finished video into a template that a coding agent refills with new photos and copy.

claims.text: vvv builds a video template once and reuses it across coding agents, using editable Remotion templates.
Status 0.1, an early release, verified end to end on macOS ARM64 with Claude Code and Codex.
The library has five templates, currently wedding films (v0.1.2 release).
Code, docs, templates and demo media are MIT.
